name: Lightforge Ingots

description: Lightforge Ingots: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: You might have found one lightforge ingot in that chest, but that's not enough to craft anything decent!
You should go back there and look for more. Maybe the murlocs around that wrecked ship have lightforge ingots on them.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Did you find the lightforge iron you need?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, you found them! Now let's get this lightforge iron hammered into something useful, eh?
